decisions.reason: The $12 change applies to the no-referral weighted allocation, not the distinct coded-referral commission; the coded flow's accepted $35 amount is already captured separately at this message.
Changing the no-referral commission amount does not itself change ticket allocation, and the accepted six-ticket rule is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
The no-referral commission amount does not change how an NFT's referral code is derived, persisted, or displayed.
The landing-page $10 copy concerns coded affiliate referrals; the source Event changes the separate no-referral weighted commission and does not direct a landing-page revision.
The no-referral commission amount does not alter coded-referral ticket issuance; the same message's four-ticket coded rule is already represented separately.
The current detailed FAQ attributes describe coded-referral commissions and do not encode a specific no-referral commission amount; the source does not explicitly request revised FAQ copy.
Changing the reward assigned when no code is used does not change referral-code eligibility or self-referral validation.
The source confirms a no-referral commission amount but does not change the Small Block prize amount, trigger, winner rules, or recorded pool allocation.

The requirement already mandates visibility of randomly distributed commissions without storing their amount; message 688's stale-attribute observation is execution evidence already represented, not a metadata-state change.

A $12 no-referral commission may require a mode-specific revision to the $30 allocation, but the source does not identify which founder or prize-pool share funds the additional amount, and the existing $10 affiliate share concerns a different flow.
The no-referral commission amount does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
Reporting must remain accurate regardless of the configured amount, and the candidate already contains the same-message verification; the source value change adds no new reporting-state attribute.
